resources.string: A clever guessing game where just_ones must be uncovered before they guess the secret word!

Every player except the detective gets the secret word that should be guessed by the detective. Each player writes down one hint word to the secret word. It must not contain any part of the secret word. The detective gets all hint words that were given by exactly one player. All duplicate words are deleted. If they guess the secret word, all players win the round.
